fusions.name: Full Draw
fusions.desc: Draws the polearm back for 1 second and looses a thrust at a target up to 6 tiles away for 30 piercing damage, up to 1.6 times that at full reach. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Split Broadhead
fusions.desc: Shoots a forked head into the first enemy it meets for 7 piercing damage; it splits and strikes 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Reach of the String
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Breath Before Release
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next strike has 20% more critical chance. Once every 10 seconds.
